scope: Bounded published-text comparison at Isaiah 54:11-12 and marker-only POB repairs; not complete Isaiah collation

4Q164.role: Hebrew pesher quotation with commentary, not continuous biblical copy
4Q164.basis: Published transcription inspected as HTML, including brackets and adjacent interpretation; no manuscript image or DJD edition inspected
4Q164.attribution: DFG project 465277421, Qumran-Digital: Text und Lexikon; based on Qumran-Woerterbuch and a predecessor text by Martin Abegg
4Q164.rights_note: Brief attributed research excerpts only, not a corpus import or relicensing of the edition under POB's license. Distinct from private QDR biblical JSON.

4Q57.basis: Published full target lines inspected; no claim this is the latest release or fresh image reading

4Q69a.basis: Published full lines inspected, including supply bracket spanning the verse boundary

qdr.rights: CC-BY-NC-4.0 corpus remains outside Git; no complete lines or verse index republished in this receipt

comparison.great_isaiah_basis: Pinned published transcription has contiguous clause without this kol; its later kol before boundary is a different position
comparison.4q57_reason: Architectural term survives, but preceding clause is supplied; reconstructed omission is not surviving absence
comparison.4q69a_reason: Target clause and architectural term are within supply brackets; opening bracket lies in verse 11 of the same physical line
comparison.verse11_reason: Foundation wording has a doubtful letter and a supplied ending on the stone word; line also contains interpretive material
comparison.working_outcome: Retain current WLC and English provisionally; do not add all before pinnacles
comparison.strongest_case_for_change: A published Hebrew quotation contains a discriminating extra quantifier
comparison.strongest_counterargument: Pesher quotation may be adapted toward its interpretation; continuous-copy control lacks the quantifier, and other fragmentary controls do not decide it

assessment.historical_review_metadata: Existing draft/revision/cross-check metadata retained byte-for-byte. Those earlier passes do not certify this edit; before/after hashes below bind the marker-only repair.

pob_repairs.before_text: O afflicted one[a], storm-tossed and not comforted, behold[b], I am setting your stones in antimony and laying your foundations with sapphires.
pob_repairs.after_text: O afflicted one, storm-tossed and not comforted, behold, I am setting your stones in antimony[b] and laying your foundations with sapphires[a].

pob_repairs.before_text: And I will make your pinnacles of ruby[a], your gates of sparkling stone[d][c][b], and all your boundary walls of precious stones.
pob_repairs.after_text: And I will make your pinnacles[b] of ruby[a], your gates of sparkling stone[c], and all your boundary walls[d] of precious stones.
